bulk2000-a-b-independent-review.json.finding: IEEE PCM preservation coverage gap survives removal of impossible injected layout behavior.

evidence.reason: Real worker invokes chain with applyAudioSelectionEffectAsync; headless service uses same actual DSP function. Removed custom callback invents a two-channel result from one-channel input.

Surviving real serial chain compares bytes only after fade→repeat→amplify→reverse→normalize with DC removal. Read-only probe found no remaining negative-zero or subnormal output and a mutation flushing those values after every DSP completion was undetected in mono and stereo.

Each real DSP completion passes through matchAudacitySelectionChannels before next DSP step. Its copying must preserve IEEE PCM; an actual reverse→repeat chain retains negative-zero and subnormal output and can protect that without injected layout.

bulk2000-a-b-independent-review.json.recommendation: Keep real DSP coverage using reverse→repeat on -0/subnormal PCM, compare bytes and owned arrays. Drop the injected mono→stereo output contract.

resolution.change: Reintroduced useful IEEE PCM/ownership behavior through actual reverse→repeat DSP for mono and stereo.
